author: miaobin
title: CPU functional tests fail with Not enough CPU resources on tensor-parallel MatMul tests

failed_jobs.name: CPU functional tests / CPU functional tests
failed_jobs.symptom: 6 of 19 failing tests throw "Not enough CPU resources!" from istreams_executor.cpp:189 on MatMulLayerTest TENSOR_PARALLEL cases; remaining 13 are unrelated error-condition tests expecting ov::Exception that was not thrown (separate, pre-existing issue).

root_cause: Several MatMulLayerTest cases configured with MODEL_DISTRIBUTION_POLICY=TENSOR_PARALLEL request a specific CPU thread/stream topology (ENABLE_TENSOR_PARALLEL=true, NUM_STREAMS=1, INFERENCE_NUM_THREADS=1) that the istreams_executor validates against the runner's actually available CPU cores. On this run the job executed on an `aks-linux-8-cores-32gb` runner, which did not expose enough usable CPU resources to satisfy the tensor-parallel executor's requirements, so istreams_executor.cpp:189 threw "Not enough CPU resources!" before the model could run. This is the same recurring infrastructure signature previously seen on a Windows runner (PR #37073, run 30544415611): the failure is unrelated to the PR under test (#38080 only touches src/plugins/intel_npu/*, an NPU-specific validation path unrelated to CPU tensor-parallel execution) and instead reflects runner CPU-resource variability affecting TENSOR_PARALLEL-configured tests regardless of OS or runner pool.
reproduction_steps: Not reliably reproducible outside CI since it depends on the specific runner's available CPU core count at test time. To attempt locally: build OpenVINO, then run `ov_cpu_func_tests --gtest_filter=*smoke_Model_Distribution_MatMul_SecondTranspose*` on a machine with fewer logical CPUs than the test's NUM_STREAMS/INFERENCE_NUM_THREADS/TENSOR_PARALLEL configuration requires.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed CPU functional tests job; this is a transient runner-resource condition unrelated to the PR's NPU changes.

Longer-term: make the TENSOR_PARALLEL smoke tests skip or gracefully degrade (rather than hard-fail) when the runner reports fewer CPU cores than the requested tensor-parallel configuration, similar to existing skip logic for other resource-constrained environments.

Separately triage the other 13 unrelated 'Expected exception ov::Exception' failures (ScatterElementsUpdate/GatherND OutOfRangeIndices tests) as they are a distinct pre-existing issue not tied to this PR or to CPU resources.
prevention_strategies: Add a runner-capacity precheck (e.g., skip/xfail TENSOR_PARALLEL smoke tests when std::thread::hardware_concurrency() or the configured runner label indicates fewer cores than required) so transient capacity dips on shared CI pools do not fail unrelated PRs' merge-queue runs.
historical_context: Identical signature previously recorded in CI Doctor MQ pattern c0a049cd23cea298: 'CPU functional tests fail with Not enough CPU resources on Windows runner' (PR #37073, run 30544415611, 2026-07-30). This is now a second, job/OS-agnostic occurrence of the same istreams_executor.cpp CPU-resource check firing on TENSOR_PARALLEL MatMul tests.
